title: Anchor Terminal ranks tools by how usable they are for agents
friendlyTitle: A directory compares tools that AI agents can use
summary: Anchor Terminal published a searchable directory covering 462 agent-facing tools across models, sandboxes, data, payments, communications and business software. Its rankings draw on public evidence about documentation, pricing, authentication, security and service history, with performance testing still incomplete.
friendlySummary: Anchor Terminal lists and scores hundreds of tools for AI agents. It compares things such as setup, security, price, documentation and reliability history.
whyItMatters: Choosing an agent tool involves more than feature lists: authentication, schemas, status history and context cost can decide whether automation works reliably. The directory is a useful shortlist, provided readers treat its methodology and unfinished probe data as part of the result.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The directory can help builders make a shorter list before testing tools themselves. Some performance tests are not finished yet, so the scores are a guide, not a final answer.
